latest_release.body:
Commit: [`e5e7830`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-analyzer/commit/e5e7830640558e323e89c831488a3172b58dc66d) \
Release: [`2026-11-09`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-analyzer/releases/2026-11-09) (`v0.3.3113`)

## New Features

- [`#23600`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-analyzer/pull/23600) (first contribution) add option to only show implicit drop hints for types with drop glue.
- [`#23558`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-analyzer/pull/23558) (first contribution) remove the "Create Rust Project" button from the welcome view.
- [`#23583`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-analyzer/pull/23583), [`#23589`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-analyzer/pull/23589), [`#23619`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-analyzer/pull/23619) add `invalid-pat-path-res`, `match-inherited-imm-ref-with-mut-ref-pat` and `unresolved-associated-type` diagnostics.
- [`#21392`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-analyzer/pull/21392) enable `jemalloc` for Linux glibc releases.

## Performance Improvements

- [`#23591`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-analyzer/pull/23591) micro-optimize lang items.

## Fixes

- [`#23598`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-analyzer/pull/23598) (first contribution) match `rustc-unicode` locations in the problem matcher.
- [`#23478`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-analyzer/pull/23478), [`#23631`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-analyzer/pull/23631) complete trait `dyn` in type location.
- [`#23606`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-analyzer/pull/23606) improve emission of associated item bounds on built-in derives.
- [`#23610`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-analyzer/pull/23610) match `rustc` coercion logic.
- [`#23608`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-analyzer/pull/23608) fix a panic in MIR evaluation.
- [`#23579`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-analyzer/pull/23579) don't suggest unreachable paths for struct literals.
- [`#23615`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-analyzer/pull/23615) fix `#[repr(i28)]` completion.
- [`#23620`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-analyzer/pull/23620) offer `destructure_struct_binding` on wildcard patterns.
- [`#23592`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-analyzer/pull/23592) offer `generate_doc_example` on re-exported item.
- [`#23554`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-analyzer/pull/23554) fix GAT bounds position after `move_bounds_to_where_clause`.
- [`#23616`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-analyzer/pull/23616) fix a panic on casts in `apply_demorgan`.
- [`#23602`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-analyzer/pull/23602) fix a panic in `generate_function` when generics are present.

## Internal Improvements

- [`#23623`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-analyzer/pull/23623) store `{Type,Const}ParamId` in `keys::{TYPE,CONST}_PARAM`.
- [`#23514`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-analyzer/pull/23514) merge `expect-test` into the rust-analyzer repo.

See also the [changelog post](https://rust-analyzer.github.io/thisweek/2026/11/09/changelog-353.html).
